title: Nitin Gadkari Witness Breakthrough of 14-km Zojila Tunnel Main Bore
summary: India's longest road tunnel on NH-1 connects Srinagar, Kargil, and Leh at 11,500 ft altitude.

blocks.content: India's longest road tunnel on NH-1 connects Srinagar, Kargil, and Leh at 11,500 ft altitude.

items: Zojila Breakthrough: Completion of full tunnel excavation between Baltal and Minamarg in Kargil district.
Project Cost: Developed by NHIDCL at ₹6,800 crore using New Austrian Tunnelling Method (NATM) and SCADA.
Strategic Value: Provides all-weather connectivity on the Srinagar-Kargil-Leh axis (completion Feb 2028).
